params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to print the selection, or the default table if omitted.
Suppress the printing dialog box, using the current print parameters.

overloads.semanticRole: PRINT SELECTION prints the current selection of aTable .
overloads.note: tool4d-lsp-stdio rejects 'PRINT SELECTION([T];*;>)' -- confirmed by live cross-check that '*' and '>' are mutually exclusive alternatives (two distinct doc syntax lines, 'PRINT SELECTION({aTable}{;*})' vs 'PRINT SELECTION({aTable}{;>})'), not two independently-combinable flags on one overload. A prior overlay revision incorrectly merged them into a single 3-param overload; reverted to keeping the two doc syntax lines as separate overloads.

params.name: aTable

Do not reinitialize the current print parameters (useful across successive calls, e.g. inside a loop).

overloads.semanticRole: PRINT SELECTION prints the current selection of aTable .
overloads.note: Second doc syntax line ('...{;>}'); autoparse dropped the '>' param here because its name ('>') doesn't match the parser's identifier pattern. Restored it explicitly.

constraints: Does nothing if the current selection of aTable is empty.
Performs the same action as the Print menu command in the Design environment.
If the user cancels the Print job dialog box (when not suppressed), the command is canceled and the report is not printed.
